title: Adversarial verdict
description: Phase 3 output: one record per finding the verifier was briefed to refute. The verdicts/ directory had no schema until now, which is how a full prose paragraph reached corrected_severity and leaked into REPORT.md verbatim.

verdict.description: unresolvable is for a claim that static analysis cannot settle at all (index reachability, live grants, production row counts). It is distinct from refuted: refuted asserts the finding is wrong, unresolvable asserts the method cannot say. Collapsing the two would print "How it was refuted" in REPORT.md under a claim nobody refuted.

evidence_reproduces.description: Did the finding's own recorded command/output pair reproduce at the baseline revision? A confirmed verdict on non-reproducing evidence is legal — the claim can be true while the citation is wrong — but it must be recorded as false.

corrected_severity.description: A bare severity token, or "" when the verdict leaves the filed severity alone. Never prose: build-report.py renders this value verbatim into REPORT.md, so a paragraph here becomes a paragraph in the severity line.

what_the_finding_got_wrong.description: Free prose, or "" when the finding was accurate as filed. This — not corrected_severity — is where narrative belongs.
